tool.name: MAGs-visualization overview-figure
tool.description: Create a page-width multi-panel overview of a MAG catalogue
tool.command: mags-visualization overview-figure --gtdb '$gtdb' #if $coverm --coverm '$coverm' #end if #if $quality.tool == 'checkm2' --checkm2 '$quality.report' #elif $quality.tool == 'checkm' --checkm '$quality.report' #end if #if $drep --drep '$drep' #end if #if $pathways --pathways '$pathways' #end if #if $metadata_cond.use_metadata == 'yes' --metadata '$metadata_cond.metadata' #if $metadata_cond.meta_cols --meta_cols #for $mc in str($metadata_cond.meta_cols).split(',') '$mc' #end for #end if #if str($metadata_cond.meta_labels).strip() --meta_labels #for $ml in str($metadata_cond.meta_labels).split(',') '$ml.strip()' #end for #end if #if $metadata_cond.sample_label_col --sample_label_col '$metadata_cond.sample_label_col' #end if #if $metadata_cond.sample_group_col --sample_group_col '$metadata_cond.sample_group_col' #end if #if str($metadata_cond.group_order).strip() --group_order #for $g in str($metadata_cond.group_order).split(',') '$g.strip()' #end for #end if #end if --panels #for $p in str($panels).split(',') '$p' #end for --width_cm '$width_cm' --font_size '$font_size' --color_rank '$color_rank' --tax_level '$abundance.tax_level' --max_taxa '$abundance.max_taxa' --hq_completeness '$quality_opts.hq_completeness' --hq_contamination '$quality_opts.hq_contamination' --mq_completeness '$quality_opts.mq_completeness' #if str($quality_opts.mq_contamination) != '' --mq_contamination '$quality_opts.mq_contamination' #end if --max_contamination_axis '$quality_opts.max_contamination_axis' --flow_ranks '$taxonomy.flow_from' '$taxonomy.flow_to' --top_n '$function.top_n' --top_modules '$function.top_modules' --module_mode '$function.module_mode' --format '$format' -o outputs && mv 'outputs/overview_figure.$format' outputs/final_figure.png

param.label: GTDB-Tk summary table
param.help: Unmodified GTDB-Tk summary with the 'user_genome' and 'classification' columns. Required for every panel.

param.label: CoverM relative abundance table
param.help: CoverM genome table with the relative abundance of every MAG per sample (including the 'unmapped' row). Needed for the abundance panel.

param.name: tool
param.label: Quality report for the quality panel
param.help: Completeness and contamination of the MAGs. CheckM2 is preferred.

param.name: report
param.label: CheckM2 quality report
param.help: CheckM2 'quality_report.tsv' with the Name, Completeness and Contamination columns.

param.name: report
param.label: CheckM quality table
param.help: CheckM lineage workflow table with the Bin Id, Completeness and Contamination columns.

param.label: dRep cluster table (Cdb)
param.help: dRep Cdb table with the 'genome' and 'secondary_cluster' columns. Needed, together with the KEGG table, for the function panel.

param.label: KEGG pathway completeness table
param.help: Output of kegg-pathways-completeness with contig, module_accession, completeness, pathway_name and pathway_class. Needed for the function panel.

param.name: use_metadata
param.label: Add sample metadata to the abundance panel?
param.help: Show treatments or other sample properties above the abundance heatmap and label or group the samples.

param.name: metadata
param.label: Sample metadata table
param.help: Table with a header line; the first column must contain the sample names used in the CoverM columns.

param.name: meta_cols
param.label: Metadata columns shown above the heatmap
param.help: Each selected column becomes one row above the heatmap. Columns with TRUE/FALSE (yes/no, 1/0) values are drawn as filled/empty squares, other columns as coloured squares.

param.name: meta_labels
param.label: Display names of the metadata rows
param.help: Comma-separated, one per selected column and in the same order, e.g. 'N. ceranae, Neonicotinoid, Probiotic'. Leave empty to use the column names.

validator.message: Only letters, digits, spaces and . , _ - ( ) are allowed

param.name: sample_label_col
param.label: Column with sample labels
param.help: Short sample names shown below the heatmap. Leave empty to use the sample names.

param.name: sample_group_col
param.label: Column grouping the samples
param.help: Samples of a group are placed next to each other and groups are separated by a gap.

param.name: group_order
param.label: Order of the sample groups
param.help: Comma-separated group values in the order to show them, e.g. 'C, P, T, N'. Leave empty for the order in the table.

validator.message: Only letters, digits, spaces and . , _ - are allowed

param.label: Panels
param.help: Panels to draw. A panel whose input is missing is skipped. Select a single panel to create it on its own.
param.option: Abundance per sample and taxon (A; needs CoverM)
Largest clusters with KEGG modules (D; needs dRep and KEGG)

param.label: Figure width (cm)
param.help: The figure is drawn at its print size: 17 cm is a full page width, 8.5 cm a single column. The height follows from the content.

param.label: Font size (pt)
param.help: Base font size at the print size; dense labels use 85% of it.

param.label: Rank used for the colours
param.help: Each taxon of this rank gets one colour, shared by all panels.

param.label: Maximum number of taxa
param.help: The most abundant taxa are shown, the rest is pooled as 'Other'.

param.label: Maximum contamination of medium-quality MAGs (%)
param.help: Leave empty for no limit (MIMAG uses 10%).

param.label: Upper limit of the contamination axis (%)
param.help: MAGs with higher contamination are drawn as triangles at the top edge and their values are listed in the legend.

param.name: flow_from
param.label: First rank of the flow diagram

param.name: flow_to
param.label: Last rank of the flow diagram
param.help: Must be a lower rank than the first rank.

param.name: group_order
param.value: C, P, T, TP, N, NP, NT

tool.help:
**What it does**
Draws a publication-ready overview of a catalogue of metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) at its final print size, so the text is legible as printed and no rescaling is needed. Up to four panels are combined; each can also be drawn on its own:
- **A – abundance**: relative abundance (% of reads) of the MAGs of each taxon per sample (CoverM), with sample metadata as rows above the heatmap (TRUE/FALSE columns as filled/empty squares), the number of MAGs detected per sample (top) and the number of MAGs per taxon (right). - **B – quality**: completeness against contamination (CheckM2 or CheckM) with marginal histograms, coloured by quality class. MAGs above the contamination axis limit are marked at the edge and listed in the legend. - **C – taxonomy**: flow (Sankey) diagram of the GTDB taxonomy between two ranks; band widths give the number of MAGs and colours the taxon of the colour rank. Labels of small taxa are spread apart so they never overlap. - **D – function**: the largest species-level (dRep secondary) clusters with the completeness of the KEGG modules of their representative MAG.
**Inputs**
- GTDB-Tk summary (required) - CoverM relative abundance table (panel A) - CheckM2 or CheckM report (panel B) - dRep Cdb table and KEGG pathway completeness table (panel D) - optional sample metadata; its first column must contain the CoverM sample names
MAG names are matched across the tables after removing file extensions such as ``.fasta``, so the outputs of the different tools can be used as they are.
**Output**
One figure in PNG, PDF or SVG. SVG and PDF keep the text editable for final adjustments.
**Tips**
- Use a width of 17 cm for a full-page figure or 8.5 cm for a single column. - If the figure gets too tall, show fewer clusters in panel D or stop the flow diagram at a higher rank.
